senses.gloss: external, foreign, not belonging to, opp. גַּוָּאָה.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 16:18">Targ. II Kings XVI, 18</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:1:3">Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>תנא ב׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01153"><he>בַּר</he></cite> I ch.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 83:1">Yalk. Gen. 83</cite> (interpret. <cite ref="H01048"><he>חָלִילָה</he></cite> <cite ref="Genesis 13:25">Gen. XIII, 25</cite>) (<cite ref="B01248"><he>בריה</he></cite>) <he>ברייה הוא לך</he> it is foreign to thy nature; v. <he>הִיצָה</he> I.—Pl. <cite ref="B01161"><he>בָּרָאֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:9">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>בתי ב׳</he> the outer chambers of the bath-house.
<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:12">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>בתי ב׳</he> the outer chambers of the heavens.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 30a:5">B. Bath. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>בשוקי ב׳</he> in the market places abroad.—Fem. <cite ref="B01285"><he>בָּרַיְתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="B01264"><he>בָּרַיְיתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 42:1">Targ. Ezek. XLII, 1</cite>; a. e.—Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81ᶜ; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 10:8:11">Y. Ned. X, 42ᵇ</cite> top <he>ארעא ב׳</he> (= h. <he>חוץ לארץ</he>) abroad; v. <cite ref="A03230"><he>אֶרֶץ</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="B01332"><he>בַּרְיָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="B01264"><he>בַּרְיָיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 30:4">Targ. Prov. XXX, 4</cite> <he>ב׳ דארעא</he> the extreme ends of &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 40b:6">B. Bath. 40ᵇ</cite> sit down <he>בשוקי ובב׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>בשוקא</he>) in markets and open places (i.e. in public).

Ḥull. 43; 47ᵃ; 58ᵇ חיוי ב׳ the animals of the prairies, v. בַּר I ch.—Esp. בָּרַיְיתָא, בָּרַיְתָא (sub. מתניתא = h. משנה החיצונה) Baraitha (or Boraitha), traditions and opinions of Tannaim not embodied in the Mishnah as compiled by R. Judah han-Nasi. [A collection of such Baraithas is found in the Tosefta (תוספתא) which bears the nearest resemblance to the Mishnah and is called by that name in Talm. Y.—The B. in frequently called מתניתא (Ch.) in contrad. to משנה (Hebr.), v.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:22">Num. R. s. 18</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 6:8">Cant. VI, 8</cite>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:3">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>.]—
<cite ref="Shabbat 19b:2">Sabb. 19ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 19b:8">Erub. 19ᵇ</cite>; a. e. <he>ב׳ לא שמיע׳ ליה</he> (cmp.
<cite ref="Shabbat 61a:9">Sabb. 61ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 101b:3">Pes. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>מתנית׳ לא וכ׳</he>) he did not know that Boraitha.
